method: A runbook was saved as a DataHub Document, edited inside DataHub through updateDocumentContents (the same mutation the UI editor lands on), and reconciled by three-way content digest. The catalog edit was pulled verbatim; the local correction was pushed compare-and-set; and with both sides moved, the push was refused and the steward's edit read back intact. The document and runbook were temporary and removed.

checks.what: the document was created and reads back byte for byte
the runbook and its document are in sync
checks.detail: The catalog document and the local runbook agree with the last sync on both sides.

checks.what: the edit landed through DataHub's own mutation
the edit is detected as catalog-ahead and pulled
checks.detail: The document was edited in DataHub (7a60ae6f6614ca1a → 6cb1f8977b5e6e79) and the catalog wins: the edited body is stored on the handoff verbatim. The structured steps predate it until someone folds the edit in.

checks.what: the steward's words are on the handoff verbatim
a second reconcile has nothing left to do
checks.detail: The catalog document and the local runbook agree with the last sync on both sides.

checks.what: a push before the pulled edit is folded in is refused
checks.detail: A body edited in DataHub was pulled at 2026-08-05T12:21:35.398Z and has not been folded into the runbook. Pushing now would overwrite that edit by the back door. Fold it in, mark it folded, then push.

checks.what: the folded runbook is detected as local-ahead
checks.detail: The local runbook changed and the catalog document has not. Safe to push.

checks.what: the push goes through and reads back byte for byte
checks.detail: Pushed 438c5aa881c616af over 6cb1f8977b5e6e79 after confirming the catalog still matched the sync base, and read it back: the catalog returns the pushed body byte for byte.

checks.what: the pushed body carries the folded steward guidance
both edits together are reported as a conflict, nothing auto-resolved
checks.detail: Both sides moved since the last sync: catalog 438c5aa881c616af → c2c7dba5fb6f0c42, local 438c5aa881c616af → 78683ad6ae9a88da. Neither side is overwritten; a person merges this.
The catalog document is at c2c7dba5fb6f0c42, and the last sync saw 438c5aa881c616af. Somebody edited it in DataHub; pushing would overwrite them. Reconcile first.

checks.what: the steward's edit is still in the catalog, read back after the refusal
checks.detail: catalog still at c2c7dba5fb6f0c42, steward's note intact
